registry.description: Betrayal is the violation of trust by someone who was trusted — the wound inflicted not by an enemy but by an ally or friend. The biblical vocabulary for this concept is folded into the words for treachery, faithlessness, and the breaking of covenant. It is one of the most theologically charged forms of relational damage because it mirrors the pattern of Israel's unfaithfulness to God. The pain of betrayal is the pain of a bond broken from the inside. [Replaced by treachery (#203).]
